name: Evals & Statistics
description: Measuring AI output quality with real numbers: rubric evals, golden sets, LLM-as-judge calibration, variance, confidence intervals, pass^k. The unblocking topic — without it no other topic can claim improvement.

name: Agent Harness Engineering
description: The agent loop, provider/tool/sandbox/engine seams, MCP clients and governed servers, skills and self-improvement — from first principles, anchored in Santara-Agent.

name: Context & Retrieval
description: Chunking, hybrid lexical+dense retrieval, reranking, context budgeting, and the measured head-to-head between compiled wikis and vector RAG.

name: Orchestration & Governance
description: Multi-agent fan-outs with contracts, human-in-the-loop gating, earned autonomy from measured accuracy, councils validated against outcomes, fleet observability.

name: Below the Prompt
description: Model internals (tokenizers, attention, KV cache), local serving and quantization, and post-training practice: SFT, DPO/GRPO, distillation — on tasks drawn from my own corpora.

name: AI for Science & Data
description: The quantitative spine: notebooks, pandas, experiment design, uncertainty quantification — first on my own systems' data, then an external scientific domain in parallel.

name: Teaching & Portability
description: De-personalizing and extracting reusable modules, docs generated from data, provenance-preserving agent workflows, assessment lanes, and teaching a second human.

name: Generative Media
description: Image/video/audio pipelines with provenance: prompt engines and style anchors, manifest-first asset lineage, scoring generated media, agent-verified procedural assets.

name: Ship & Operate
description: Deployment, supervision, inference serving, CI everywhere, secrets hygiene — getting from 'run these in two terminals' to something that runs while you sleep.
